subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.**

When the owner stopped paying the workers, a lot of them went **__rogue__**.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ruffian."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Rogue"** means behaving differently from other similar people or things, often causing damage. (अपने सदृश व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं से भिन्‍न आचरण करने वाला और प्रायः नुक़सानदेह)

 
 
• **Example**: *This is a **rogue**__ program.*
